The VRI Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana edition contains Pāḷi texts (Tipiṭaka, Aṭṭhakathā, Ṭīkā), usually presented in Roman, Devanāgarī, Burmese, or other scripts. Its content is Buddhist and its vocabulary is Pāḷi, not Sikh devotional verse in Gurmukhi.
